evidence.title: GitHub - thisisfel1x/supabase-shadcn-database-example: Demo project showcasing how to fetch, filter, and display supabase data in a tanstack table with server-side rendering · GitHub

name: Supabase + TanStack Table Demo
summary: Demo project that fetches, filters and paginates Supabase data server-side and shows it in a TanStack Table with shadcn/ui.
description: Shows one approach to server-side data tables with Supabase: server-rendered fetching, a basic filtering system, and lazy loading where only the rows of the current page are fetched along with the table's total size. The extended shadcn data table lives in a single basic-data-table component; demo data is generated with Faker.
contains: server-side fetching, filtering and pagination from Supabase
only the current page of rows is loaded, plus a total count query
